rule: 新增层层必须先在此表登记；界面源文件里的 z-index 一律 var(--layer-*)

layers.name: canvas-grid
layers.purpose: 画布底纹网格：所有内容的下方，不参与交互

layers.name: canvas-ambient
layers.purpose: 环境光晕与其伪元素：底纹之上、面板之下

layers.name: flow-figure
layers.purpose: 流程图 SVG 画布：面板内部的基准层
layers.note: rendered observation: `.flow-svg` did not exist in the DOM on any of the 12 routes at 1440/820/390, so this layer is declared in the stylesheet but unobserved in the product -- suspected dead style, not deleted here

layers.name: flow-node
layers.purpose: 流程图节点：基准画布之上，只在 .flow 内部比较
layers.note: rendered observation: `.node` did not exist in the DOM on any of the 12 routes at 1440/820/390; paired with --layer-flow-figure as one suspected dead component

layers.name: topbar
layers.purpose: 壳层顶栏：与路由面板同文档流，靠相对定位

layers.name: nav-rail
layers.purpose: 宽屏固定侧栏：盖住内容列，不盖住浮层

layers.name: drawer
layers.purpose: 离屏抽屉族（工作区抽屉与窄屏侧栏）：导航之上、遮罩之下
layers.note: `.sidebar` computes 88 only at <=840px (measured: 88 at 820 and 390, `auto` at 1440 where it is a sticky column); `.drawer` computes 88 at every width

layers.name: scrim
layers.purpose: 模态遮罩：压住抽屉与页面，接受点击关闭

layers.name: palette
layers.purpose: 命令面板：遮罩之上的可输入浮层

layers.name: toast
layers.purpose: 瞬时通知：所有浮层之上，不接收焦点

layers.name: skip-link
layers.purpose: 键盘跳转链：仅在聚焦时出现，必须高于一切
